description: The member's calendar, events, invitations found in mail, the job search schedule, and the page where the member connects a Google or Microsoft calendar. Actions: view, export_ics, event, event_context, mail_invitations, schedule, schedule_sources, connect_link. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.

calendar_event_id.description: A calendar event's id from get_calendar view (events[].id).

mail_message_id.description: A received message's id: its Mailbox id (i-…) or the same id without "i-" (a calendar event's or RSVP draft's mailMessageId); either works.

params.description: Fields for the action. Call with action "help" to list each action's fields.

name: get_calendar
title: Read the calendar
